title: Long-run check-in: latest merged blueprint epoch vs the Stage 4 blueprint
description: Discovery, a cheap monitoring signal only. B is the latest merged epoch of the sharded long run packed by `make blueprint-checkin` (artifacts/blueprint/bundles/long-checkin); A is the Stage 4 blueprint bundle (artifacts/blueprint/bundles/final). The same seed at every check-in, so successive check-ins share deals and lineups.
